headline: アグマチンは、細菌の脱水素酵素のNADPH結合を34倍強める
subhead: apo結晶構造とSAXSで、NADP+が加わると酵素が閉じた配置になることを示した

summary.question: 細菌のスペルミジン合成は、プトレッシンから始まると考えられてきた。アグマチンを好む酵素がある理由は分かっていなかった。
summary.approach: アグマチンを使う脱水素酵素（CAPADH）を B. fragilis と C. leptum で、速度論・熱シフト・SAXS・apo 結晶構造で調べた。
summary.result: アグマチンでは kcat/Km がプトレッシンの 115 倍（B. fragilis）と 811 倍（C. leptum）になり、NADPH の結合は 34 倍強まった。
summary.learned: 両酵素はアグマチンを初発基質とする CAPADH だった。アグマチンが構造変化を促して NADPH の結合を高める誘導適合が示唆された。
summary.open: アグマチン結合型の構造はなく、認識ループの役割は変異体解析で確かめる必要がある。

question.quote: Putrescine has long been considered the initiating substrate for aspartate semialdehyde-dependent bacterial spermidine biosynthesis.
This variation appears to be common, but the mechanistic basis for substrate preference was unknown.

approach.quote: Here, we investigate the aspartate semialdehyde-dependent dehydrogenases from Bacteroides fragilis and Clostridium leptum using steady-state and transient-state kinetic assays, mass spectrometry, thermal shift protein stability assays, X-ray crystallography, small-angle X-ray scattering, and computational modeling.

result.quote: Indeed, the kcat/Km increased 115-fold for B. fragilis and 811-fold for C. leptum in comparison to putrescine.
Agmatine enhances NADPH binding affinity by 34-fold, whereas putrescine has a modest effect

learned.quote: Both enzymes exhibit dramatically enhanced catalytic efficiency with agmatine, demonstrating that these homologs function as carboxyaminopropylagmatine dehydrogenases rather than carboxyspermidine dehydrogenases.

These structural transitions, together with thermal stability measurements and transient-state binding assays, support an induced-fit mechanism in which agmatine promotes conformational rearrangements that enhance NADPH-binding.

open.quote: mutagenesis studies are needed to confirm our hypothesis of substrate recognition.

highlights.text: アグマチンがあると、NADPH の解離定数は 61 μM から 1.8 μM へ 34 倍下がった。プトレッシンは 2 mM でも NADPH の解離速度を 29 s−1 までしか下げなかった。

evidence.quote: Accordingly, the equilibrium value decreased 34-fold from KNADPH = 61 μM to KAgm:NADPH = 1.8 μM (Table 3).
but the off rate only decreases to 29 s−1 indicating 6-fold weaker NADPH binding

highlights.text: apo 型では NADPH の結合部位がふさがれていた。B. fragilis では β7-α8 ループの残基 174〜178 が結合溝に入り込み、C. leptum では L84・P85・N107 の位置が NADPH と衝突する。

evidence.quote: In the BfCAPADH-Apo structure, residues 174 to 178 of the β7-α8 loop are positioned within the NADPH binding channel, forming a hydrogen bond with G11, and must be displaced to allow the association of NADPH.
The NADPH binding site is still occluded, but by more subtle repositioning of L84, P85, and N107 that would cause steric clash with NADPH

highlights.text: SAXS の回転半径は B. fragilis の NADP+ 型 35.4 Å、apo 型 36.7 Å、C. leptum の apo 型 40.3 Å で、結晶構造の傾向と合った。NADP+ や NADPH があると両酵素は、より閉じた配置をとる。

evidence.quote: BfCAPADH-NADP+ forms a compact crystal structure with a SAXS Rg = 35.4 ± 0.2 Å, while BfCAPADH-Apo is more extended with a SAXS Rg = 36.7 ± 0.1 Å.
the presence of NADP+ or NADPH causes both proteins to adopt a more compact domain arrangement, and that the crystal structures are representative of the conformational trends observed in solution.

lab_notes.purification: CAPADH の発現・精製は既報の方法。SAXS 用にはニッケルアフィニティーの後にゲルろ過を追加した。
lab_notes.sample_prep: シッティングドロップ、4 °C。B. fragilis は 4 mg/ml・クエン酸アンモニウム・PEG 3350、C. leptum は 5 mg/ml・LiCl・Tris・PEG 8000。
lab_notes.data_collection: SSRL 12-1/12-2 で 100 K、XDS で処理。8DEB のチェーン A で分子置換。B. fragilis は B 因子が高く、平均 100 超の残基は除いた。

evidence.quote: The expression and purification of BfCAPADH (WP_005801052.1) and ClCAPADH (EDO61991.1) followed our previously published methods.
evidence.section: Expression and purification of BfCAPADH, ClCAPADH, and BfCAPADC

evidence.quote: A size exclusion chromatography purification step was added after nickel affinity chromatography as described previously (7).
evidence.section: SAXS sample preparation and data analysis

evidence.quote: All crystals were grown in sitting drop trays with a 1 μl: 1 μl ratio of protein and well solution at 4 °C.
BfCAPADH crystals were grown using 4 mg/ml protein in a well solution of 0.15 M ammonium citrate dibasic and 22% PEG 3350.
ClCAPADH crystals were grown using 5 mg/ml protein in a well solution of 0.85 M lithium chloride, 0.1 M Tris HCl pH 7.5, and 28% PEG 8000.
The ClCAPADH structure was solved by molecular replacement using Phenix Phaser (24) with 8DEB, Chain A as a model.
evidence.section: ClCAPADH data collection and structure determination

evidence.quote: Residues with average B-factors >100 were removed even when apparent electron density was visible.
evidence.section: BfCAPADH data collection and structure determination

editor_notes: 構造は apo 型 2 つ（C. leptum 9YQ9 2.5 Å、B. fragilis 36YL 2.91 Å）のみで、アグマチン結合部位は Boltz-2 の予測と配列比較による仮説（論文が変異体解析待ちと明記）。そのため記事ではアグマチンによる構造変化を「示唆」にとどめた。本文は PDB ID を「36GY」と誤記し、データ可用性の節と Table 4 では 36YL と 9YQ9 の対応が図の凡例と逆になっている（PDB 側の 9YQ9=C. leptum, 36YL=B. fragilis に従った）。Table 4 の B. fragilis の精密化分解能（1.94 Å）も本文の 2.91 Å と食い違う。C. leptum 酵素は PDB 初の構造（first_structure=true）なので New Structure に入る。
